messages:
alex: Heads up — saw a reproducible 99th pct latency spike on long-context workloads when the node is under KV pressure. Started after we flipped the default to adaptive-LRU. Memory climbs, paging kicks in, and latency jumps for a few minutes.

maya: Ugh. Can you paste the short repro and the logs?

alex: Quick repro: run the long-context perf harness with sequence_len=32k, batch=6, mix of reads+appends to the same hot keys. Command: `./run_perf --seq 32000 --batch 6 --hotset 2% --runtime adaptive-lru`

alex: Attached snippet from the agent log around the spike:```
kv_cache: allocator used=93% free=7%
pager: triggered page-out, paused allocs=1.2s
latency: p99=320ms -> p99=2.8s
kv_reuse: misses++ reuse_frag=0.43 -> 0.72
```

ryan: Do you have KV stats (reinsert counts, tombstones, active slab distribution)? Those reuse_frag numbers look like fragmentation.

alex: Yes — reinsert rate spikes right before the page-outs. Tombstone ratio goes up from ~0.5% to ~6% during the burst. Hot slab occupancy oscillates.

sophia: Sounds like reinsert-order inversion + kasync with LRU can cause a short-term hotset churn that the pager interprets as noise and thrashes. We saw similar patterns with FIFO in a different cluster but not this severe.

maya: Interesting. Can you switch policy to FIFO on a canary and repro? Want to know if it's policy specific or something else (e.g., reinsert race).

alex: Did a quick canary: `runtime.policy=fifo` — p99 still jumps but peak is lower and duration shorter. Weirdly, FIFO reduced tombstone accumulation but increased immediate misses.

ryan: That matches a hypothesis: FIFO avoids constant promotion/reinsert which limits fragmentation, but it can increase short-term misses. LRU reinserts create more pointer churn under heavy concurrent appends. If reinserts interleave with the pager, you get stale pointers -> tombstones.

alex: I captured a tiny repro trace (pprof-like): link: https://internal.perf/trace/1750003210/flamegraph (short). Flame shows ~40% time in kv_reinsert path and a spike in page-fault handling.

infra-bot: deploy event: adaptive-lru rolled to canary workers at 2025-04-02T11:02:09Z by @alex

sophia: Two quick experiments: 1) add a short cooldown on reinserts (coalesce reinserts within 50ms) 2) prioritize pager background sweeps when LRU churn > threshold. Both are cheap to try.

maya: Agreed. Also add a KV metric: reinserts_per_second_by_key and tombstone_age_hist. We need to correlate age vs page-out timing.

alex: I pushed a branch with coalesce and a hotset hint that pins top 1% keys to avoid pager eviction during bursts. Running 30m stress now.

ryan: If this repro is quick, let's schedule a perf-run on dedicated hardware (no noisy neighbors). I can set up a job with `--isolate=dedicated` and collect full perf counters.

alex: Will do. Preliminary results: coalesce halves the p99 duration and reduces tombstones by ~60%. Not production-ready but promising.

sophia: Nice. Follow-ups: a) add unit test for reinsert order under concurrent append+evict b) run extended stress to catch rare races c) evaluate hybrid policy (FIFO for last-N accesses, LRU for others).

maya: I'll create an eng-runtime ticket and tag you all. Assign to alex for immediate triage.

alex: Thanks — I'll drop the perf artifacts and exact command lines into the ticket. :thumbsup:
